notes.title: Trivia Night 0.2 Update Released! New Game Modes, Turkish Language and more!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i68.tinypic.com/f0tdw5.png[/img]

[h1]What's New[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Math[/b] game mode!
[*][b]Words[/b] game mode! (Online)
[*]Language screen and Turkish language.
[*]New questions added.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Red screen problem fixed.
[*]Fun with flags menu button fixed.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[*]Game architecture set to 64bit.
[*]Some answers changed.
[*]Menu UI color changed.
[*]Answer button color changed.
[*]Few sound changes.
[*]Few typo fixes.
[*]Removed fun with flags score limit.
